actions: import pyautogui; pyautogui.doubleClick(1852, 768); import time; time.sleep(3)

import pyautogui, time; pyautogui.click(1000, 400); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','a'); time.sleep(0.3); code = 'Sub Fix
names = Array("ReadMe","Raw_data","Beans","Millet","Sorghum","Mkt Gotheye","Mkt Mangaize","Mkt Ouallam","Mkt Tera","Millet spatial integration")
oComps = StarDesktop.Components.createEnumeration()
Do While oComps.hasMoreElements()
oC = oComps.nextElement()
If HasUnoInterfaces(oC, "com.sun.star.frame.XModel") Then
If InStr(oC.getURL(), "workbook-with-sample") > 0 Then
oDoc = oC
End If
End If
Loop
If IsNull(oDoc) Then
MsgBox "NOTFOUND"
Exit Sub
End If
oSheets = oDoc.Sheets
actual = oSheets.getElementNames()
n = 0
For i = 0 To UBound(names)
idx = -1
For j = 0 To UBound(actual)
If LCase(Trim(actual(j))) = LCase(Trim(names(i))) Then idx = j
Next j
If idx = -1 Then
For j = 0 To UBound(actual)
a = LCase(Trim(actual(j)))
b = LCase(Trim(names(i)))
If InStr(a, b) = 1 Or InStr(b, a) = 1 Then idx = j
Next j
End If
If idx >= 0 Then
oSheets.moveByName(actual(idx), n)
n = n + 1
End If
Next i
oDoc.store()
MsgBox Join(oSheets.getElementNames(), " | ")
End Sub'; pyautogui.write(code, interval=0.01); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('f5'); time.sleep(3)
